snippet.title: Junebug - First Look Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Junebug is a cat companion and cozy building game. Create charming little spaces, make them your own, then experience what you’ve built through your cat. Explore, play, relax, and enjoy the little moments you create together.

Wishlist today on steam https://store.steampowered.com/app/4704810/Junebug/
